title: Free credits for indie/game devs: make assets with our tool, top views by July 15 win (self-promo, but there's free stuff + I want feedback)
author: libriarian-fighter
selftext:
Hey everyone — full disclosure first: I help build Dro, an MCP/tool that generates game-ready 3D assets (clean topology, Unity/Roblox-ready) from a prompt, inside Claude. So yes, this is self-promo. But there's free stuff and I'd genuinely rather get roasted by real devs than run ads.

We just opened a creator contest. The deal is simple:

* Make anything with Dro assets — a clip, a screenshot, a tiny game, whatever.
* Post it (any platform), clearly show the asset, and say it's made with Dro.
* Most total views by July 15 wins.

Prizes are credits you can spend on anything — models, game assets, animations, low- and high-poly exports:

* 1st: 5,000 credits
* 2nd: 1,500
* 3rd: 750

Why a contest instead of ads: we want real devs putting it through real pipelines and telling us where it breaks. So honestly — even if you don't care about winning, if you try it and the topology comes out as triangle soup or the export fights your engine, tell me here. That feedback is the actual point.

Rules + link in the comments (keeping the post clean per sub rules). Happy to answer anything about how the geometry/exports actually hold up.
